explanation: Try each possible start unless the pattern begins with an anchor. Match literal characters or dots recursively; for a starred atom try all matching repetition lengths, and honor an ending dollar anchor.
timeComplexity: Exponential worst-case backtracking; O((n+1)^(p+1)) is a safe upper bound for text length n and pattern length p.
spaceComplexity: O(p) recursion depth, excluding the supplied strings.
